manifest_note: The frozen F0 case denominator. A case that is not fully specified can never be re-run or disproved, so every case carries both arms, a fault arm, a mutant, two differently grounded denominator sources, its invalidation inputs, and an explicit measurement state. UNMEASURED is a first-class result here; there is no vocabulary for 'not checked' that reads like a pass.

authoring_provenance.written_by: the F0 implementer, in a write-only stage
authoring_provenance.consequence: every F0 runtime case below is UNMEASURED at authoring time. The MEASURED cases are the frozen four-carrier census taken BEFORE this changeset by the supervisor; they are asserted here as DATA and are deliberately not re-measured, because a re-measurement would overwrite a finding with whatever this environment happens to produce.

carrier_facts_provenance.source: private supervisor carrier census (artifact set adev-f0-evidence-lHQCBUCy). The raw captures are account-bearing and are NOT reproduced here or anywhere in this repository; only field names, presence and counts are recorded.
carrier_facts_provenance.effective_configuration: The operator's installed settings FILES were unchanged on disk. The ingress rows were nevertheless captured with an ADDITIVE --settings hook overlay on the command line, so the EFFECTIVE configuration in force during the capture was AUGMENTED. Saying 'installed settings unmodified' without saying that would overstate the rows: they describe an augmented configuration, not a stock installation.
carrier_facts_provenance.sessions: TWO separate native sessions, not one: the stream-json ingress and hook-result capture, and a distinct text-output OTel exporter probe. A row taken in one session is not evidence about the other, and the two are never merged into a single observation.
carrier_facts_provenance.measured_scope: top-level Read ingress only, on this machine
carrier_facts_provenance.not_covered: Serena and other MCP tool routes, write-protection hooks, remote consumers, subagent-dispatched tools. None of these were observed and none may be inferred from the rows that were.
carrier_facts_provenance.freshness: These are FROZEN HISTORICAL observations. They must not be relabelled as fresh executions and must not be generalised to a carrier that was not measured.

join_status.reason: The full tool -> hook-result -> OTel join was never established. Live Read ingress and stream-json tool ids join exactly, but 0 of 7 hook-result records carried a tool_use_id. The dispatcher OTel records DO carry session.id and prompt.id; what they lack is any TOOL- or HOOK-level identifier -- no tool_use_id, no hook_id, and traceId and spanId undefined -- so the missing link is specific rather than a claim that those records are empty. No exact key spans all three surfaces. Nearness in time or a shared session is not a join and may never be substituted for one. Serena and other MCP routes and every remote consumer were not observed at all and stay UNMEASURED.
join_status.consequence: Any later control whose case requires that join records the carrier UNMEASURED rather than passing on a weaker key.

cases.subject: bootstrap/control_trust/trustcheck.py budget against bootstrap/control_trust/rung_scope.json, stage=source
cases.stimulus: the real worktree at the pinned base, and throwaway private repositories seeding one budget defect each
cases.opposite_arm: CB-0: the unmutated instrument against the real worktree at its own pinned base must be PERMITTED, or every refusal below could equally mean the instrument refuses everything
cases.fault_arm: an empty changeset, an unpinned or unresolvable or non-ancestor or superseded base, a repository whose local configuration (including through include.path) carries a clean or process filter, a promisor remote or a partialClone extension, a staged mode-160000 gitlink, and an unavailable git are each refused BY NAME rather than scored as clean. The configuration refusal happens BEFORE the first object or worktree query, because the query is what would run the effect. It is a named boundary, not a sandbox, and the pinned /usr/bin/git 2.39.3 has no GIT_NO_LAZY_FETCH to close the fetch route by environment.
cases.mutant: MB-3: narrow the runtime classifier to a path prefix so a helper parked outside the tree stops counting; the instrument must then PERMIT what the same fixture otherwise refuses as over budget

runner.config: no global config, no system config, no system attributes file, no hooks, no external diff or textconv, no index refresh. GIT_ATTR_NOSYSTEM does NOT disable attributes: an in-tree .gitattributes still applies, so a configured filter is refused by name rather than suppressed by environment.
